summary: Connected turns now enforce the signed environment control: a halt refuses turns, continuations, direct commands and the next model step or tool call; a budget ceiling only lowers limits; a per-process rate limit caps turns per principal. New option controlFreshness.
howTo: Nothing to do for createGlirastes().chatTurn(): it now hands loadControl and admitTurn to createAiChatHandler and createChatInteractionsHandler. While halted the chat answers HTTP 503 { error: 'assistant_halted' } (or 'control_unknown' with controlFreshness: 'required' before the first successful sync after process start); a running turn ends at its next model step or tool call with the error text 'The assistant is halted.' (a tool call already running finishes). A refused rate limit answers HTTP 429 { error: 'turn_rate_limited' } with Retry-After; the limit counts every chat request of a principal in this process, not across instances. The chat shows its generic error for these; a refused tool step reads the new locale key activityFailureAssistantHalted. The control lives in process memory: set controlFreshness: 'required' in production so a restarted process serves no turn before its first sync. A custom streamHandler calls ctx.managedTurn.beforeModelStep() before each model call. Heartbeats now carry technicalMetadata.controlSequence and assistantState.
